notable_quotes: Activated solids 1a and 2a are luminescent and can respond to metal ions in water, with PL spectra recorded versus Cd(NO3)2 and Fe(NO3)3 concentration.
Compounds 1a and 2a show measurable thermal stability, evidenced by reported TGA curves for both activated materials.
Both 1a and 2a exhibit TNT-dependent luminescence changes in CH3OH, indicating potential nitroaromatic sensing behavior under methanolic conditions.
